prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080. Composition must be SQUARE, never wide or landscape.

CRITICAL — READ FIRST: (a) the drawing must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES with NO frame, NO border line, NO box and NO white margin band; (b) there must be NO starburst, no radiating burst, no sparkle rays and no sunbeam rays anywhere in the picture; (c) use a ZOOMED-IN composition where the main character and the background props all run past every edge of the square, so nothing floats in empty white space.

SCENE: A cheerful cartoon MITOCHONDRION character is the friendly little power station inside a busy muscle cell, filling almost the whole frame, zoomed in close.
- The MITOCHONDRION CHARACTER is one big, chunky, rounded JELLYBEAN / KIDNEY-BEAN shape, drawn large enough to fill most of the square. It has a big round happy face in the middle of its body: two large round eyes with pupils, cheerful eyebrows, a wide open cheerful grin, and two short stubby cartoon arms with simple mitten hands.
- A neat scalloped panel is peeled back like an open jacket flap on one side of the character's body, showing the cozy inside: along the inner rim, draw a row of WIDE WAVY RIBBONS that fold inward from the rim like a rippled curtain, each ribbon a simple thick wavy line with a rounded free edge, evenly spaced with clean white gaps between them — like the pleats of a rippled curtain hanging just inside the open jacket flap. In the open space behind the curtain of ribbons, draw one small round tangled scribble loop (its own tiny energy core) and two or three tiny plain dots.
- One mitten hand holds up a big friendly LIGHTNING-BOLT CHARACTER with a small round happy face and stubby little arms and legs — a fresh battery of energy it just made — as if proudly showing it off.
- On the other side, a tiny round OXYGEN-BUBBLE character (a plain circle with a small smiling face, holding hands with a partner circle, the two joined together) and a small crumb-shaped FOOD character (a rounded lumpy blob with a tiny happy face) are arriving, walking or floating in toward the mitochondrion's open jacket flap, about to be welcomed in.
- BACKGROUND, filling the rest of the picture and running off the edges: two or three smaller bean-shaped mitochondria friends peeking in from the corners, each with a simple happy face, partly cut off by the image edge; a loose scatter of small plain circles and tiny dots floating in the open space to suggest the busy inside of a muscle cell; a few more tiny lightning-bolt characters, without faces, drifting off toward the edge of the picture as if heading out to power the rest of the cell.
- Everything is drawn LARGE, SIMPLE and CHUNKY, with generous open white areas inside every shape so a child can colour them in.

STYLE — coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with plenty of white space.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN — the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion rays or halo of rays behind, around or under any character or the lightning-bolt character. NO radiating lines of any kind anywhere. They leave a big empty shape that cannot be removed afterwards.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, shelf, table, counter or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind. Do NOT draw a thin black line anywhere near the edge of the image. There must be NO white margin between the artwork and the image edge.
- The artwork must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES of the square — the background mitochondria friends and the drifting lightning bolts are CUT OFF by the image edge itself.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO detached free-floating ribbon shapes drawn separately from the open jacket-flap rim — every wavy ribbon must clearly connect to the rim it folds in from.
- NO human figures, no real flames, no arrows.
